summary: The bearer can issue Voice of Command Orders to friendly OGRYN units and can lead a BULLGRYN SQUAD or OGRYN SQUAD. Use the bearer’s normal Order allowance and the army rule’s timing, range and restrictions.
Once per battle per model, when Damage is allocated to this Rogal Dorn Battle Tank model, reduce that Damage to 0.
When the selected friendly ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE is targeted in your opponent’s Shooting phase, reduce Damage allocated to its unit by 1 this phase. Apply the core minimum Damage rule.

Friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD, OGRYN SQUAD and RATLINGS gain ABHUMAN. Friendly COMMISSAR models add friendly ABHUMAN units to their eligible Order recipients; retain their normal Order allowances and option limits.
Before the selected friendly Astra Militarum unit has shot, grant it re-rolls of Hit rolls this phase.

The selected friendly Astra Militarum VEHICLE may move through all terrain, ignoring vertical distance, for Normal, Advance or Charge moves this phase. Source review: the effect triggers at move-ended rather than during the move; confirm the permission’s activation and legal ending positions.
When the selected friendly Astra Militarum unit is targeted in your opponent’s Shooting phase, worsen incoming AP by 1 for that attack sequence.
At the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, friendly units embarked in this Valkyrie may disembark. Apply the core disembark eligibility and placement rules.
This Krieg Command Squad unit has Feel No Pain 6+ against mortal wounds only.

The bearer adds Target Weak Spot to its Order options: improve the ordered unit’s ranged AP by 1 against defenders within 12″ of the attacker. Apply Voice of Command range, allowance, duration and eligibility.
After this Commissar Graves unit charges, optionally select one engaged enemy and roll D6: 1 does nothing; 2–3 deals D3 mortal wounds; 4–5 deals 3; 6 deals D3+3.

For this Banesword unit’s quake cannon attacks, set the defending unit’s Deadly Demise threshold to 3+. Source review: the effect has no destruction trigger or duration for changing the defender’s ability; confirm when that threshold applies.

Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM models gain +1 to ranged Wound rolls if they disembarked this turn. Source review: the disembarked condition does not bind the recipient or transport; confirm who qualifies before applying the benefit army-wide.
This Leman Russ Battle Tank unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1. The source supplies no objective-dependent full re-roll branch; do not add one without checked wording.

At battle-round start choose one artillery support mode: shake enemies on 5+ for -2″ Move and -2 Charge; scatter selected enemies to remove cover; or grant selected friendly units Stealth. Limit affected units to 2/3/4 for Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught, lasting the round; enemy targets must be outside 12″ of friendly units. Source review: this provisional source’s shaken selection rolls every enemy before applying a maximum; confirm the selection procedure.

After a unit disembarks from this upgrade transport, it may declare a charge despite disembarking if the bearer model made a Normal move this turn. Source review: the movement condition uses this-model but the disembark filter uses this-unit, and the subject allows any owner; confirm the transport/model and friendly-unit binding.
The bearer gains OFFICER and Voice of Command, with two Orders for friendly ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC or SQUADRON units. Use the army rule’s menu, timing, range and restrictions.
After the friendly SQUADRON unit Advances, its ranged weapons gain Assault for the rest of the turn.

At the end of your Command phase, a friendly-controlled objective in control range of this unit or the bearer’s transport becomes sticky until control is lost. Source review: the source does not bind an embarked bearer to the transport or identify which objective the final effect secures; confirm that selection.

When using Orders, if this unit has Master Vox, set the bearer’s Voice of Command target count to three. Source review: the source modifies targets, not Order uses, and does not explain whether one Order is copied or three separate Orders are issued; confirm the distinction.

Friendly REGIMENT ranged attacks gain Lethal Hits against targets that are neither MONSTER nor VEHICLE; friendly SQUADRON ranged attacks gain Lethal Hits against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets. Born Soldiers is explicitly provisional; confirm current wording.
This Catachan Heavy Weapons Squad re-rolls ranged Hit and Wound rolls of 1 against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets. Source review: the source is marked partial; confirm any omitted restrictions.

Once per turn per unit, at phase start, Graves may select a visible Battle-shocked friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit within 24″ with at least two models. Destroy one of its models, then remove Battle-shocked. Source conflict: the approximate note instead says 12″ and claims the cost/gates are absent; confirm range and conditions.

Once per turn per unit, at phase start, Graves on Foot may select a Battle-shocked friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit within 12″ with at least two models. Destroy one model in that unit, then remove its Battle-shocked state.
This equipped Bullgryn or Ogryn Bodyguard model has a 4+ invulnerable save.
At the end of your Movement phase, the selected friendly Astra Militarum unit makes a D6″ Normal move. It must not have Remained Stationary this turn or arrived from Strategic Reserves this phase.
This Cadian Command Squad unit re-rolls Battle-shock tests while it contains an OFFICER and is within control range of an objective marker.

Once per battle per unit, at phase start, select one friendly DRAYDEN’S LANCE unit to heal D3+2 wounds. Source review: no range or eligible model/allocation rule is supplied; confirm the healing recipient and intended limits.

When this Rogal Dorn Commander model is selected to shoot, optionally re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll. Source conflict: the imported scope lasts the phase while the pinned scope differs; confirm each allowance and its expiry.

Select an engaged friendly PLATOON unit. Callous Sacrifice permits shooting at enemies and may destroy a model in this unit on 4+ after damage to an engaged enemy. Source conflict: shooter/target engagement restrictions and the sacrifice recipient are not clearly bound; confirm who may shoot whom and when the casualty is removed.
Missing source mechanics: Calm Under Fire contains only a no-effect marker. Supply checked wording before using the enhancement.

When a friendly Astra Militarum SQUADRON or TITANIC unit is selected to shoot, it may shoot while engaged under the encoded friendly-engagement gate and ignore worsening Hit-roll modifiers for non-Indirect Fire attacks. Source conflict: the imported scope differs from the pin and the engagement condition refers to an unbound defender; confirm target eligibility and duration.
Use on a friendly Astra Militarum unit that disembarked this turn and has not shot. It re-rolls Hit and Wound rolls against defenders within control range of an objective marker this phase.
This Hellhammer model ignores worsening ranged Hit-roll modifiers while an enemy is engaged with it.
Close-range Detection adds 3 to the detection range of visible enemies within 6″ of this unit this phase. Source gap: the supplied rules do not define detection range or its measurement procedure.

For this Doomhammer’s magma cannon attacks against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets, treat the defender as within half weapon range. Source review: this is provisional; confirm the half-range treatment and its duration.
After the friendly ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit shoots, select one enemy it hit. That enemy loses cover and friendly ARMOURED SKIRMISHER attacks against it gain +2 Strength this phase.

While the bearer leads this Militarum Tempestus unit, it can be affected by two Orders concurrently. Source review: this source is provisional; confirm concurrency and interaction with the normal one-Order limit.
This Cyclops model may embark in a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT as INFANTRY and occupies seven transport spaces. Apply capacity and core embark restrictions.

When this Stormsword selects targets for its siege cannon in your Shooting phase, roll D6 for the defender and each unit within 3″ of it, including friendly units. On 5+, mark that unit; after this model’s attacks resolve, each marked unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

After this Hippogriff AFV shoots in your Shooting phase, it may make a D6″ Normal move and cannot charge this turn. Source review: the move uses event-subject without an explicitly bound shooter; confirm the moving recipient.
Missing source mechanics: Coordinated Action contains only a no-effect marker. Its core phase/CP metadata does not supply a usable effect.

At the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, the selected friendly Astra Militarum INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit gains Feel No Pain 6+ this phase. Source review: the accompanying enemy -1 Hit condition says closest among eligible targets without naming the closest subject; confirm which attacks suffer the penalty.

When Fire Overwatch targets this Cadian Heavy Weapons Squad, its hits succeed on 5+, or 4+ while within 6″ of a friendly PLATOON unit, for that resolution. Source review: the source does not specify unmodified dice or whether succeeds-on is a threshold; confirm the full Overwatch rule before use.

At the end of your opponent’s turn, unengaged Gaunt’s Ghosts may enter Strategic Reserves and gain Deep Strike, arriving in the next Movement phase even in round 1. Source review: the provisional source expires at the next Shooting phase; confirm the arrival exception and expiry.
Before the selected friendly PLATOON unit has shot, its ranged weapons gain Precision this phase.

The selected friendly Astra Militarum VEHICLE may pass through terrain during Normal, Advance or Charge moves this phase. Source review: the trigger is move-ended, too late to grant movement permission; confirm activation and legal ending positions.
At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy within 18″ of this Scout Sentinels unit. Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM models re-roll Hit rolls of 1 against that enemy this phase.

When this Leman Russ Commander unit is destroyed in your opponent’s Shooting phase, before Deadly Demise, roll D6; on 2+ this model shoots. Source review: this provisional record lacks removal/resolution details and a clear destroyed-model binding; confirm the complete shoot-on-death procedure.

At the start of your Command phase, if this Death Korps unit is below Starting Strength, optionally return D3 destroyed DEATH KORPS TROOPERS, or D3+1 if at least two models carry death-korps-medi-packs. Source review: the first branch does not require even one pack; confirm equipment eligibility and placement.
Missing source mechanics: Death Mask of Ollanius contains only a no-effect marker. Supply checked wording before use.

Deathstrike Missile allows placing or relocating a Deathstrike target marker anywhere during Shooting. Source gap: the provisional source has no firing/detonation procedure, damage or range and marks usage as first-this-battle; confirm how the complete missile rule works.
This Aegis Defence Line unit has the Benefit of Cover. This effect targets the fortification itself, not nearby infantry.

After this Cyclops model or an enemy ends a move, if this model is within 3″ of an enemy, select one enemy within 3″, destroy the Cyclops and roll D6: 1 does nothing; 2–5 deals D3 mortal wounds; 6 deals D6. Apply the separate Deadly Demise rules only as the current source permits.
This Ratlings unit gains GRENADES. The source is provisional; confirm current equipment eligibility.

Set up this Aegis Defence Line model as ten connected sections. Source gap: the provisional record omits section spacing, coherency and terrain placement restrictions; confirm the complete deployment procedure.

Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY with SMOKE and friendly SCOUT SENTINELS gain Signal Flares: optionally mark one visible enemy within 12″ in your Shooting phase for +3 detection range this phase. The detachment uses the exclusive RECON tag. Source gap: detection range and tag-selection procedures are not defined here.
After an enemy ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, the selected unengaged friendly PLATOON unit within 8″ makes a 6″ Normal move.
This unit’s Snap shooting hits succeed on 4. Source gap: confirm whether this means a 4+ threshold, unmodified rolls and the Snap shooting procedure; the effect does not define them.

While the bearer leads a unit and Remained Stationary this turn, that unit’s ranged attacks score Critical Hits on 5+. Source review: the effect gates on the bearer’s move rather than the whole unit and omits unmodified-roll wording; confirm those restrictions.
While the bearer leads a REGIMENT unit, that unit gains Scouts 6″.

After this Basilisk shoots in your Shooting phase, enemy INFANTRY hit by its Earthshaker cannon are shaken: -2″ Move and -2 Charge until the next Shooting phase. Source review: this provisional source’s hit-history selector uses this-unit rather than each recipient; confirm affected targets and which player’s Shooting phase ends it.
Each HEAVY WEAPONS GUNNER model in this Krieg Heavy Weapons Squad occupies two transport spaces.

Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY may be set up on this emplacement terrain and end moves on it. Source review: this provisional source does not define the eligible platform surface or placement restrictions.
Before the selected friendly Astra Militarum TITANIC unit fights, select one engaged enemy. Gain +6 melee Attacks and +2 melee AP this phase, and direct melee attacks only at that selected enemy.

When the bearer uses Omnissiah’s Blessing, add 3″ to its target’s Move until your next Command phase. Source review: the modifier uses event-object without explicitly binding the healed vehicle; confirm that recipient.
This Tech-Priest Enginseer model has Lone Operative while within 3″ of a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit.
The bearer model gains Feel No Pain 4+.

When this model uses an Order on this-unit, optionally select up to two other friendly PLATOON units within 3″ and mark them affected-by-order. Source gap: no Order option is copied and no duration is supplied; confirm the triggering recipient, copied benefit and expiry.

Choose re-rolls of Damage rolls or Attacks rolls for friendly DRAYDEN’S LANCE units. Source gap: no choice timing, refresh or weapon scope is supplied; confirm those limits rather than changing the choice for every roll.

Select a friendly REGIMENT unit and a different friendly SQUADRON unit, both not yet selected to shoot; Fields of Fire grants +1 AP against a designated enemy this phase. Source gap: the effect selects an enemy without binding it to the two core targets’ attacks and supplies no designation trigger; confirm the target-selection procedure.

Once per turn per army, this Avenger may shoot at an enemy FLY unit after it destroys another friendly Astra Militarum unit within 6″ in your opponent’s Shooting phase. Source conflict: an alternative attacks-resolved trigger has no FLY or casualty binding; confirm the reaction sequence and target.

Final Duty allows this Krieg Heavy Weapons model to shoot on death. Source gap: no destruction trigger, die gate, eligibility, resolution timing or removal procedure is encoded; confirm the complete rule.
Use on a below-Half-strength non-OFFICER SQUADRON unit. For this battle round, its ranged weapons other than One Shot gain Hazardous, and it ignores Ballistic Skill and ranged Hit-roll modifiers.

If your Warlord is a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER, friendly TEMPESTUS SCIONS gain BATTLELINE and +1 Objective Control. Friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units gain +1 ranged Hit when selected to shoot after being set up this turn. Source conflict: the imported effect differs from the pin; confirm the current Warlord gate and arrival benefit.

When the friendly KASRKIN or MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit is selected to shoot, its hot-shot lascarbines, lasguns, laspistols, marksman rifles, volley guns and sentry hot-shot volley guns gain +1 Strength and +1 AP against defenders within 12″ this phase.

This Hydra model re-rolls Hit rolls against FLY targets.
Before the selected friendly Astra Militarum CHARACTER unit has shot, re-roll its Hit rolls against defenders within 12″ this phase.

Enemy units cannot target this unit with Fire Overwatch. Source review: the effect has permanent duration without an activation event; confirm how Flash Grenades are used and how long protection lasts.

The selected friendly Astra Militarum OFFICER units add REGIMENT and SQUADRON to eligible Voice of Command recipients this phase. Core metadata says one or more target units; confirm whether any additional selection or cost limit applies.

After this Hellhound shoots in your Shooting phase, select one enemy it hit. That enemy loses the Benefit of Cover until the next Shooting phase. Source review: the expiry does not specify whose Shooting phase; confirm the intended duration.
Missing source mechanics: Focus Attacks contains only a no-effect marker. The core Command-phase metadata does not supply an effect.
In the Shooting phase, subtract 1 from incoming Hit rolls against this Aegis Defence Line unit.

After this Manticore shoots in your Shooting phase, select one enemy hit by storm eagle rockets that is neither MONSTER nor VEHICLE. It is staggered and loses 1 Objective Control until the next Shooting phase. Source review: confirm which player’s Shooting phase ends the effect.
Before the selected friendly SQUADRON unit has shot, improve its AP by 1 against defenders within 12″ of this unit this phase.
Before the selected friendly PLATOON unit has shot, add 1 to ranged Attacks against enemy targets within half weapon range this phase.
While this Cadian Castellan leads a unit, that unit may shoot after Falling Back.

After deployment, while this unit is on the battlefield, select up to two friendly REGIMENT or SQUADRON units to redeploy, optionally into Strategic Reserves ignoring limits. Source conflict: the effect sequences battlefield placement and reserve placement instead of alternatives; confirm the redeployment procedure.
In your Command phase, the bearer can issue one additional Voice of Command Order. Apply its ordinary recipient, range, option and concurrency restrictions.
Once per turn per unit, Grenade costs 0CP when targeting this Krieg Combat Engineers unit. Apply the core Stratagem timing, eligibility and cost rules.

This Death Korps unit gains +1 Hit while below Starting Strength and also +1 Wound while below Half-strength. Source review: this source is marked partial; confirm any omitted conditions or attack-type restrictions.

If this Krieg Command Squad unit matches OFFICER, it may use Stratagems despite Battle-shocked and lifts Voice of Command duration limits. Source review: this provisional source does not explain which Order limit is lifted or bind the OFFICER model condition; confirm those interactions.

After deployment, if the bearer is on the battlefield, redeploy up to three other friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY units, optionally into Strategic Reserves ignoring limits. Source conflict: the effect sequences two placements instead of alternatives; confirm the redeployment procedure.

This Catachan Command Squad unit’s ranged weapons gain Assault if it matches OFFICER. Source review: the condition tests a unit keyword rather than the presence of an officer model; confirm the intended eligibility.
This Leman Russ Executioner model gains +1 Hit with its executioner plasma cannon against defenders below Half-strength.
Missing source mechanics: Hasty Extraction contains only a no-effect marker. Confirm the embark reaction and its restrictions from checked wording.

Yarrick may choose a stance in Command until the next Command phase: Counterstrategist reacts to an enemy moving or arriving within 8″ using a visible friendly REGIMENT within 6″ for a D6″ move, shooting on 6s, or a charge; Decisive Command sets Order range to 12″; Inspiring Hero grants friendly Astra Militarum within 6″ Battle-shock and Leadership re-rolls. Source review: the provisional Counterstrategist lacks a bound enemy and clear response timing, and its outer Command condition conflicts with later reactions; confirm the complete stance procedure.
This Ministorum Priest model re-rolls melee Hit rolls while not Battle-shocked.
This Attilan Rough Riders unit may shoot and declare a charge after Falling Back.

After this Drayden’s Lance Attilan Rough Riders unit Falls Back, it may still shoot and declare a charge. Source review: permanent scope does not specify the permission’s expiry; confirm its duration.
This Commissar Graves on Foot unit may shoot and charge after Falling Back. The source is provisional; confirm current wording.

From battle round 2, the selected friendly Astra Militarum TITANIC unit in Strategic Reserves can be set up within 8″ of a battlefield edge and at least the encoded 6″ from enemies. Source review: the effect does not identify the normal arrival replacement window or whether the enemy distance is strictly more than 6″; confirm setup boundaries.

This Cadian Recon Squad’s Orders last until replaced, Battle-shocked or battle end. Source conflict: the provisional duration modifier references the Cadian Castellan’s issue-Orders record instead of the shared Voice of Command benefit; confirm the actual Order duration interaction.
The bearer model gains Feel No Pain 6+.

In your opponent’s Command phase, the selected friendly Astra Militarum OFFICER model may issue an Order as if it were your Command phase. Apply its normal allowance, recipients, range and option restrictions.

For SQUADRON units Advancing, Iron Tread gives a fixed 6″ addition instead of an Advance roll. Source review: its approximate note also permits passing through, but not ending in, enemy Engagement Range; the effect only sets a roll to 6 and omits that movement permission. Confirm the full rule.

After this Sly Marbo model shoots in your Shooting phase, if unengaged it may make a Normal move and cannot charge this turn. Use its normal movement distance; no fixed extra distance is supplied.

This upgrade unit gains Infiltrators.
